controls.negative: Planted defects must fire: (1) shuffled/corrupted self-solutions rejected by numeric verifier; (2) corrupted router (misroute_rate=0.85) degrades routed accuracy below base and is rejected by verified_update_gate; (3) legacy 12-minute interference cap flags maths cells as TIMEOUT/under-sized; (4) broken Python code candidate fails executable test gate; (5) in a flat world where all served experts have identical pass rates on executable tests, bandit_cold has zero regret and does not beat uniform random.
controls.positive: Clean references must pass: (1) verified self-solutions pass 100% of numeric verifier checks; (2) deterministic prompt router classifies held-out Night-MoE prompts with accuracy >= 0.98; (3) sized timeouts cover full-pack evaluation times with >= 1.6x safety factor and zero TIMEOUT cells; (4) reference Python solutions pass 100% of executable unit tests; (5) oracle upper bound is never beaten on expected pass rate across all 20 paired seeds, and near_oracle_90 sits strictly between oracle and uniform.

decision_rules.HM_S14_02: Rejection-sampled verified self-solution adapter on maths (n=200) beats gold-text SFT adapter (exact paired McNemar p < 0.05), beats cross-domain control adapter (H1, p < 0.05), beats base model on base-parsed items (H2, p < 0.05), and is ACCEPTed by verified_update_gate while gold-text SFT is REJECTed.
decision_rules.HM_S14_03: Router domain accuracy >= 0.98 on held-out items; gated routed Bee MoE beats both base and the best single adapter (routing plateau) across the full Night-MoE evaluation suite (exact paired McNemar p < 1e-10) with zero cross-expert interference harm and verified_update_gate ACCEPT.
decision_rules.HM_S14_04: Full 4x6 pack-by-adapter grid (20 off-diagonal transfer/interference cells) evaluated at full pack sizes (no n=100 limit) as one Bonferroni family (alpha_bonf = 0.05 / 20 = 0.0025), with per-stage timeouts sized from measured per-item latency so timeout_cells == [] and missing_cells == [].
decision_rules.HM_S14_07: Executable-test code expert (100% of training rows verified by isolated Python test runner) and verified-target cyber MCQ pack beat both base and matched control (exact paired McNemar p < 0.05) and pass verified_update_gate (ACCEPT).
decision_rules.HM_S15_03: On real executable-test coding/math/security/astronomy tasks routed across served experts via StrategyManager, best single expert (routing plateau) is measured first; bandit_cold and bandit_warm_budgeted beat best_single_served_expert_plateau and uniform on >= 18/20 paired seeds, and bandit_warm_budgeted achieves lower early regret than bandit_cold on >= 16/20 seeds.
